description: This file defines the interface MedicationDispenseDAO which declares database access methods related to the MedicationDispense domain within the OpenMRS project. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, and deleting MedicationDispense records based on various criteria.

classes.name: MedicationDispenseDAO
classes.description: Interface for database operations related to MedicationDispense entities in OpenMRS.

methods.name: getMedicationDispense
methods.description: Retrieves a MedicationDispense by its internal ID.

methods.name: getMedicationDispenseByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a MedicationDispense by its UUID.

methods.name: getMedicationDispenseByCriteria
methods.description: Retrieves a list of MedicationDispense objects matching specific criteria.

methods.name: saveMedicationDispense
methods.description: Saves or updates a MedicationDispense record in the database.

methods.name: deleteMedicationDispense
methods.description: Deletes a MedicationDispense record from the database.
